question: Find the value of frac{9(3-5)-5 { of } 4 div 10}{-3 times 5-2 times 4 div 2} :
solution:
**Given:**

The expression is (9(3-5)-5 times 4 ÷ 10)/(-3 times 5-2 times 4 ÷ 2) .

**Formula Used:**

BODMAS rule (Bracket, Order, Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction)

**Calculation:**

 Rightarrow (9(3-5)-5 times 4 ÷ 10)/(-3 times 5-2 times 4 ÷ 2) 

 Rightarrow (9(-2)-20 ÷ 10)/(-15-8 ÷ 2) 

 Rightarrow (-18-2)/(-15-4) 

 Rightarrow (-20)/(-19) 

 Rightarrow (20)/(19) 

**The value of the given expression is (20)/(19) .**
